ov: About 40 species of fast birds of prey with thin, tapered wings, found on every continent except Antarctica. Unlike hawks and eagles, which kill with their talons, falcons kill with a notch on the side of the beak.

cf.tip: Falcons kill with a tooth-like notch on the beak and have long, pointed wings. Hawks kill with their talons and usually have broader wings.

fx: Females are typically larger than males, which lets a pair take a wider range of prey.
